Kagylóminta (03 §4.2 E)

Abbreviations (US terms)
ch – chain
dc – double crochet
sc – single crochet
sh – shell
sk – skip
st(s) – stitch(es)

Stitch key (US terms)
chain (ch)
single crochet (sc)
shell (sh): 5 dc in same st
increase (inc): 3 dc in same st

Kagylóminta
Row 1 – foundation: ch 20.
Row 2: skip 1 ch, sc, [sk 2 ch, sh, sk 2 ch, sc] 3 times (19 sts). Turn.
Row 3: ch 3 (turning chain), 3 dc in next st, sk 2 sts, sc, [sk 2 sts, sh, sk 2 sts, sc] 2 times, sk 2 sts, 3 dc in next st (19 sts). Fasten off.
